title: Couverture Chocolates
description: Premium couverture chocolate made from Davao’s finest single-origin cacao. A healthy indulgence that brings the natural richness of the Philippines to life.

title: Desserts
description: Artisanal truffles, nama, and bonbons, handcrafted with our signature velvety-rich chocolate. A perfect blend of creativity and comfort.

title: Drinks
description: Smooth, decadent chocolate drink made with premium couverture chocolate. Enjoy it hot or iced for a comforting, guilt-free indulgence.

title: Sweet Treats
description: Mindful snacking with wholesome ingredients designed to satisfy your chocolate cravings, perfect for a delicious pick-me-up.
